newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers tallow to West Africa under GSM-102.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers tallow to West Africa under GSM-102.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it was offering tallow, grease and lard to the West Africa region through its export credit GSM-102 program.

Countries in the region are Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Congo, Ivory Coast, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Liberia, Mali, Mauritania, Nigeria, Senegal, Sierra Leone, and Togo.
USDA has offered $50 million in GSM-102 credits to the 19 nations in fiscal 1997. Of it, $1.5 million was reserved for sales of breeder livestock.
